name: instant-worker — deploy build-Job failures detected (30m) [silent-deploy-failure backstop]
description: Fires when deploy_status_reconcile detects Kaniko build Jobs landing in a Failed state at a sustained rate. instant_deploy_job_failed_detected_total is the metric from the 2026-05-30 silent-deploy-failure incident (CLAUDE.md rule 27, Bug A): the reconciler now queries BatchV1().Jobs after the runtime Deployment query, so a Failed build Job (BackoffLimitExceeded / DeadlineExceeded) flips the deployments row to 'failed' even when the build pod was GC'd before the runtime Deployment existed. reason="DeadlineExceeded" = the platform's Kaniko build slot is timing out for many tenants (image bloat / degraded GHCR push path); reason="BackoffLimitExceeded" = the modal Dockerfile-error bucket (per-customer, expected at a low rate). P1: user-visible, recoverable — a customer's deploy silently failed. Threshold 0.5/s sustained 30m catches a platform-wide build degradation while tolerating individual bad Dockerfiles. Source: worker/internal/jobs/deploy_status_reconcile.go; counter DeployJobFailedDetectedTotal in worker/internal/metrics/metrics.go.

nrql.query: SELECT rate(sum(instant_deploy_job_failed_detected_total), 1 second) FROM Metric WHERE service = 'worker' FACET reason
